title: Number active sessions by age
description: For active sessions assign row_number from oldest to newest by started_seq ASC, then session_id ASC for ties. Return exactly four columns: session_id, database_name, started_seq, age_rank. Final sort: age_rank ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT session_id, database_name, started_seq,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
       ) AS age_rank
FROM sessions
hints: ROW_NUMBER() needs no PARTITION BY here: numbering is global for all active sessions.
The ORDER BY inside OVER must fully match the age rule.
solution_explanation: ROW_NUMBER creates a deterministic active-session queue with session_id as the tie-breaker.
